description: #14 §4's cycle with the mark on `b`, as the resolution words it: marking `b` errors. Marking it also pins it, so this exercises the cut, not the fixpoint — `throwing-cycle-every-member` is the one an unsound engine fails.

diagnostics.message: Call to `a` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `a` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
